# Arrival save fixture

`arrival-v2.sav` is a 131,088-byte Flash1M save written through the Cormoria ROM's in-game Save menu and cold-reloaded by libmGBA. Its selected save slot resumes in Carabrue Town Home 1F (map 79:1, warp 255); SHA-256 is `b6493f464b5d114090ad9c6672be94ff852582f49ee3adaef1c4a09760ebc2ed`.

The fixture carries identity registry version 2 and remains a historical save sample.

`arrival-v3-cormoria-carabrue.sav` is a 131,088-byte registry-v3 Flash1M save written through the current Cormoria ROM's in-game Save menu and cold-reloaded by pinned mGBA 0.11. It was seeded from a synthetic registry-v3 adaptation of the older fixture, then overwritten by the ROM; it is not a fresh-new-game save. The source ROM is the clean two-world build at `f59cc59416`, Cormoria ROM SHA-256 `11c510cec9e03ce84a713aa982eea70da08619d30dd7da5c199cff4836a9326c`. The save SHA-256 is `c17f39cd98342281ab0de668a6b9daa83f264f058ac642a55d5b5543f90e6765`. `verify_arrival_save` accepts registry v3, map 79:1, warp 255 and layout 1194. Catalog contract tests use this immutable image instead of modifying a save's registry bytes in Python.

`arrival-v3-cormoria-rivetshore.sav` is a 131,088-byte registry-v3 Flash1M image from a clean new game in the Cormoria ROM at `083a888abf`, ROM SHA-256 `29ca007af1239df0ab60fe6bd7a9ef2d62b43c6285eed6d0879dfa3aaa02522e`. The new character completed the Carabrue home introduction and saved in-game (SHA-256 `92229f2bb0c384b83878841dd067cc69211afd92ee4dac696ad774cd27bfd8d7`). A scratch copy of that save was moved to Rivetshore Harbor by changing only `SaveBlock1` position, map and layout, with its sector checksum updated (staged SHA-256 `9d8e49b5d402302194d837ac50315bf3e697c482371b166cc22356944c86190d`). The ROM then continued at the harbor and wrote this final save through its in-game Save/overwrite flow. The staged Flash slot remains byte-identical in the final image; the new slot has counter 2. Pinned mGBA 0.11 cold-continued the final image at Rivetshore Harbor, and its bytes remained unchanged. SHA-256: `89b8fd74cbdd0505cc17fc0b4d213e3c90a4384c0690108f87c0929bb9887369`. The strict verifier accepts registry v3, map 82:21, warp 255 and layout 1314.

`arrival-v3-main-lilycove.sav` is the corresponding 131,088-byte image from a clean new game in the Main ROM at `083a888abf`, ROM SHA-256 `a5ad7e66a5de6b7946af906df529e5f8326c8ab484d283e94135edee95a9dd95`. The character left the moving truck, entered the Littleroot home and saved in-game (SHA-256 `90e3c8629e79b1dcf4425c58eb80a0b83d02fd007a94f4b15fa46a261c809c8a`). A scratch copy changed only `SaveBlock1` position, map, layout and sector checksum for Lilycove Harbor (staged SHA-256 `9c93fa676546a3bef68526f506861b3eb8fac80af7bb643653f97a1dc96a4a53`). The Main ROM continued at the harbor and wrote this final image through Save/overwrite. The staged Flash slot remains byte-identical in the final image; the new slot has counter 2. Pinned mGBA 0.11 cold-continued at Lilycove Harbor without changing the file. SHA-256: `35446e3d010391257ab28c8a6842798e36da02da66e2cbb9c6f553138d42f4fd`. The strict verifier accepts registry v3, map 13:10, warp 255 and layout 88.

The Carabrue image remains a contract fixture. The Rivetshore and Lilycove images are first-arrival candidates; final release validation still needs the exact release ROMs, map-to-layout bindings against those ROMs and a live cross-ROM player-data roundtrip.
